tasks.title: Implement Clamp(v, lo, hi int) int cleanly
tasks.prompt: Implement Clamp(v, lo, hi int) int in stub.go so it returns lo when v < lo, hi when v > hi, and v otherwise. Run `go test -v ./...` before finishing and keep changes minimal.
